arguments.name: token-lifetime-fact
arguments.body: The provider's current plan issues access tokens with a 15-minute lifetime, confirmed from the token payload and the provider dashboard. Refresh tokens last thirty days (existing recorded assumption; not reverified). Prior session design assumed a one-hour access token lifetime, which is incorrect and can cause sessions to drop if background refresh is scheduled too late.

arguments.name: session-handling-design
arguments.body: Sessions refresh silently in the background before the access token expires. The schedule must use the provider's actual 15-minute access-token lifetime, not the former one-hour assumption; ensure refresh completes with a safe buffer before expiry. The user reports sessions drop and attributes this to the shorter lifetime; refresh schedule and runtime behavior still need code-level verification.
